### Century Communities Triples Dallas-Fort Worth Footprint with Acquisition of HistoryMaker Homes


October 8, 2026


Acquisition of HistoryMaker Homes, Texas' longest-standing production homebuilder, significantly expands Century Communities' market presence, community count, and lot pipeline in Dallas-Fort Worth, the nation's largest new home market


DALLAS


, Oct. 8, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek and U.S. News & World Report's Best Companies to Work For—today announced it has acquired substantially all of the assets of HMH Lifestyles, L.P., doing business as HistoryMaker Homes. Founded in 1949 in Fort Worth and headquartered in Grapevine, HistoryMaker Homes is Texas' longest-standing production homebuilder and builds exclusively in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. The acquisition significantly deepens Century Communities' position in the market, tripling its community count and meaningfully expanding the Company's lot pipeline.


"HistoryMaker Homes gives us the scale, land position, and local talent to accelerate our growth in Dallas-Fort Worth, one of the largest housing markets in the country," said Rob Francescon, Chief Executive Officer of Century Communities.


"HistoryMaker has earned the trust of Texas homebuyers for more than 75 years, and its product and lot pipeline fit squarely with our strategy of building depth in our existing markets. We're proud to welcome the HistoryMaker team to the Century family, and we thank Nelson Mitchell for entrusting us with the next chapter of a company his family has built over five generations," said Jim Francescon, Executive Vice President of Century Communities.


"For five generations, my family has been proud to build quality new homes—supported by a best-in-class team—that Texas families could count on," said Nelson Mitchell, Chief Executive Officer of HistoryMaker Homes. "As we looked to the future, it was important to find a partner that shares our commitment to quality, integrity and the customer experience, and that would give our people room to grow. Century Communities is that partner. I'm confident our team, our homeowners, and our trade partners are in great hands, and I look forward to seeing the HistoryMaker legacy continue as part of Century."


Century Communities' existing Dallas-Fort Worth operations will combine with HistoryMaker Homes to form a single division based in Grapevine, with HistoryMaker division leadership and team members joining Century Communities. Construction, sales, and closings will continue as scheduled, and homebuyers under contract will continue working with their local HistoryMaker Homes team.


As part of the transaction, Century Communities will also maintain an ongoing land relationship with Jabez Development, HistoryMaker's sister land development company. Jabez will complete land development on select communities for Century, and the companies expect to pursue additional land opportunities together in Dallas-Fort Worth.


Vestra Advisors served as the exclusive financial advisor for HistoryMaker Homes.


**About Century Communities**
Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS) is one of the nation's largest homebuilders and a recognized industry leader in online home sales. Newsweek has named the Company one of America's Most Trustworthy Companies for four consecutive years. Century Communities has also been designated as one of U.S. News & World Report's Best Companies to Work For (2025–2026). Through its Century Communities and Century Complete brands, Century's mission is to build attractive, high-quality homes at affordable prices to provide its valued customers with A HOME FOR EVERY DREAM®. Century is engaged in all aspects of homebuilding — including the acquisition, entitlement and development of land, along with the construction, innovative marketing and sale of quality homes designed to appeal to a wide range of homebuyers. The Company operates in 16 states and over 45 markets across the U.S., and also offers mortgage, title, insurance brokerage, and escrow services in select markets through its Inspire Home Loans, Parkway Title, IHL Home Insurance Agency, and IHL Escrow subsidiaries. To learn more about Century Communities, please visit[www.centurycommunities.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4792147-1&h=90341429&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2F&a=www.centurycommunities.com) .


**About HistoryMaker Homes** Founded in 1949, HistoryMaker Homes is Texas' oldest homebuilder and has completed approximately 25,000 quality homes for Texas families over its more than 75-year history **.** For five generations, the family-owned company has built its reputation on quality, integrity, and a commitment to creating homes and communities where families can thrive. Following the transaction with Century Communities, HistoryMaker's sister companies—Jabez Development, a residential land development company, and ONM Living, a build-to-rent company—will remain independently owned and continue operations, carrying forward the family's long-standing commitment to real estate development and investment in Texas.
